title: unified-rollouts-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-enhancements
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: Rolling out new model variants (canary / A/B / shadow) requires robust automated rollback when quality or latency regresses. This PR centralizes autorollback logic in the unified rollouts engine, adds multi-metric quorum evaluation, improves telemetry for rollback root-cause analysis, and hardens safety guards for shadow traffic probing. Motivation: incidents in Dec/Jan showed slow detection for subtle quality regressions when signal was fragmented across multiple metrics and regions. Goals: (1) reduce time-to-detect regressions, (2) avoid noisy single-metric rollbacks by requiring configurable quorums, (3) provide better observability and post-mortem data to SRE and product teams, (4) keep behavior backward compatible by gating new defaults behind feature flags. Changes included are a mix of runtime code, config defaults, tests, and observability wiring. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of multi-metric quorum evaluation engine - [x] New safety guard: min-sample-size and staged-quarantine window - [x] Telemetry: add per-rollout metric snapshots, pre/post-rollout diffs - [x] E2E tests for canary -> quarantine -> rollback path - [x] Unit tests + integration tests for feature flags - [x] Docs: rollout-config reference and migration notes - [x] Manual QA in staging across eu-west and us-west Notes on compatibility and rollout: Default behavior remains unchanged unless org enables the new "multi_metric_quorum" policy in rollout configs. Admins can opt-in per-namespace or pin at project level. There is a short migration path for legacy rollout configs documented in docs/rollouts/migration.md. Backport: Changes were backported to release/2026-02-rc1 for customers using Dedicated rollout guard rails. Impact: Lower false-positive rollback rate observed in internal canary runs (see telemetry snapshots attached to this PR).

b7d4c11: perf(runtime): short-circuit metric evaluation for low-latency canaries
c2e6f9a: docs(rollouts): rollout-config reference + migration notes
e1f7a33: ci: add e2e workflow for staged-shadow environments

changed_snippets:
# rollouts.yaml (defaults)
multi_metric_quorum:
  enabled: false
  quorum_required: 2
  min_sample_size: 100
review_comments: Diego Morales (2026-02-15): Please make quorum_required configurable per-metric in addition to overall quorum. Some metrics are higher-signal and should be weighted. Response (Aisha): Added a per-metric weight map and fallback to uniform weights when not specified (see quorum_evaluator.rs).

Priya Singh (2026-02-18): Observability looks good but we should avoid adding high-cardinality tags by default. Suggest sampling for debug snapshots. Response (Aisha): Implemented sampled snapshots (1%) and full snapshots gated behind 'debug_rollout_snapshots' flag; updated dashboards and docs accordingly.

Evan Liu (2026-02-22): Tests flaked in CI on first run (staged-shadow e2e). Can you add retry logic and reduce timing sensitivity? Response (Aisha): Added deterministic timing hooks in e2e harness and retried failing assertion with exponential backoff; re-ran CI and all tests passed.

QA (Samira Khan) (2026-02-25): Manual staging validation: triggered canary with intentional latency regression; autorollback triggered after 4m and quarantine window opened as expected. Logged follow-up to SUP-4821 for customer-facing doc examples.
ci_checks: e2e (staged-shadow): initial run failed (timing flake) -> rerun -> pass
merge_result: Merged by Aisha Patel via squash and merge on 2026-03-01. Commit message consolidated. No conflicts. Backported patch to release/2026-02-rc1 and marked changelog for next minor.
release_notes: Enhancements to unified rollouts: - Multi-metric quorum evaluation to reduce noisy single-metric rollbacks - Staged-quarantine window and min-sample-size safety guards - Telemetry: per-rollout metric snapshots and pre/post-rollout diffs - Feature flags to opt-in per-namespace/project - E2E tests added for canary->quarantine->rollback path Admin action: To opt-in to the new quorum behavior set multi_metric_quorum.enabled=true in your rollout config. See docs/rollouts/migration.md for migration steps.
post_merge_actions: Created runbook draft for SRE: docs/rollouts/runbooks/autorollback.md
Notified product and SRE teams in #rollouts and #oncall for monitored canaries for 48h
notes_for_release_manager: This change is opt-in by default. Recommend enabling for internal canaries for 2 weeks, monitor 'rollout.rollback_rate' and 'rollout.quorum_reasons' telemetry. No forced migration required.
